market.title: CHARMINAR MARKET
market.intro:
Four made-up companies. Buy a few shares, watch two years go by one quarter at a time, and learn what moves a price — and what moves you.

First: a practice round with ₹10,000 that is not real. Then, if you like, your own savings.
market.disclaimer: Made-up companies. Assumptions, not promises. Scored on what you do, not on what you make.
market.deposit_hint: From your savings of {amount}. How much?
market.need_savings: Save at least ₹500 to open a real run.
market.paper_first: The real run unlocks after one practice round.
market.chart_empty: Prices move when you press NEXT QUARTER
market.how: Tap + to buy 5 shares, − to sell 5. Each trade costs ₹20.
market.hold: No orders: you hold what you have.
market.panic: You sold into the crash. The Professor noticed.
market.banyan: Banyan Savings would have given {amount}. Fees paid: {fees}.
market.what_you_did: What you did (this is what counts):
market.paper_note: The tip and the crash come in the real two-year run.
market.verdict4: Textbook. You behaved like an investor, not a gambler.
market.verdict2: Decent. Look at the crosses — that is where the market gets people.
market.verdict0: The market taught you something expensive today. That is what practice is for.
market.settled: Everything is sold back into your savings. No fee on the final sale.
